title: Interact Club Installation Ceremony

description:
The Interact Club Installation Ceremony was held with great enthusiasm under the theme “Empowering Young Leaders.” The ceremony marked the beginning of a new chapter for the young Interactors, encouraging them to embrace leadership, responsibility and service.

The programme commenced with the meeting being called to order by the outgoing President, Zoya Kaur Sanghera. The traditional lighting of the lamp and Saraswati Vandana set an auspicious tone for the proceedings.

A vibrant dance performance added energy and colour to the occasion. Outgoing President Zoya Kaur Sanghera then shared her experiences and reflections from her tenure, highlighting the importance of teamwork, commitment and service.
